defaults.video_script: Messi came off the bench in the sixty-first minute and scored a hat-trick in nineteen minutes. Copa America Centenario, Chicago, June two thousand sixteen. Nicolas Otamendi had opened the scoring in the seventh minute. Messi replaced Nicolas Gaitan after sixty-one minutes. He scored in the sixty-eighth, seventy-eighth and eighty-seventh minutes. Sergio Aguero added a fifth in stoppage time. Argentina won five-nil. Has any substitute ever matched Messi's nineteen minutes?
